messages:
sara_ml: Heads-up — local eval-harness runs are flaking for quantized model bring-ups on my M1. Repro: `eval-harness run --config local_q.yaml --model rdx-small-8bit`

dan_devex: Can you paste the small log chunk? Is it failing during compilation or the runner?

sara_ml: failing at runner step — sometimes panic with OOM-like message, sometimes metric collector times out. snippet: ```
[2025-08-10T14:02:23Z] runner: start run id=342
[2025-08-10T14:02:25Z] kvcache: restored 0 entries
[2025-08-10T14:02:27Z] runner: error: metric-collector timed out after 30s
exit code 70
```

anna_ng: two quick things: (1) try `--seed 42 --no-shuffle` for local runs to reduce nondeterminism, (2) quantized models can spike mem at compile-time depending on kernel selection.

mike_ops: we should also add a local config validator that runs before the harness executes. Saw `batch_size: '16'` as a string in your yaml once -> silent cast caused weird behavior. Example check would be a JSON schema + `--validate-config` CLI flag.

ci-bot: build/2367-evals-pipeline failed: flaky-test detected (threshold 1/3). See https://ci.redwood.xyz/2367 for logs :warning:

sasha: For CI, we should pin the eval seed in pipeline YAML (e.g., `EVAL_SEED=2025-08-10`) and enable `--validate-config`. Also, add a `--dry-run` mode that just validates config + dataset sanity without touching GPUs. That will catch config issues fast.

dan_devex: Agree on `--dry-run`. Also proposing a new CLI flag `--local-workers N` that defaults to 1 to avoid OS thread oversubscription on dev machines. Small PR incoming.

sara_ml: Tried `--seed 42 --no-shuffle` + `--local-workers 1` — looks much better, but got a metric regression compared to fp16 baseline: EM dropped from 72.5 -> 69.4 after 8-bit quant. Not sure if it's eval harness bug or quantization quality loss.

anna_ng: log the raw logits + postprocessing diffs in the report; if logits change drastically then it's quant loss, if logits same but postproc differs then harness bug. Also consider adding a compact per-example checksum to detect ordering/dup issues.

mike_ops: I'll sketch a lightweight config JSON schema and a `validate_config.py` hook that CI can call. If folks like, I can add it as a pre-check in the Github Actions job for evals.

sasha: Sounds good. Action items: mike -> PR for validator + GH job change; dan -> CLI flags PR (`--dry-run`, `--local-workers`, `--validate-config`); anna -> small doc blurb for local-run troubleshooting; sara -> collect failing example ids and attach to the ticket.

sara_ml: thanks — filing ticket now: https://issues.redwood.xyz/RED-1345 (attached logs + failing ids). :white_check_mark:
